answer: A near-duplicate is rejected at the copper gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. Copying an answer therefore yields nothing, and producing 67 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the orchard ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the haven review can re-run it. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
